summary: Feature 'Traguardi del Cammino' (Fase 1) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass after fixing one 500 in POST /api/admin/achievements/{id}/assign (and /unassign) — u['id'] used instead of u['user_id']. GET /api/me/achievements: 401 without auth; demo user returns 12 achievements with earned_count=6, plans_bronze/silver earned, plans_gold NOT earned (3<7); earned_at is idempotent across repeated calls. Admin CRUD + reorder + walk-board GET/PATCH persistence all pass. Listener user is correctly rejected (403) on all /admin/achievements* and /admin/walk-board endpoints. Frontend: login via /auth OK, Home 'home-bacheca' card → /traguardi shows armadio (wood cabinet) with all 12 medals grouped by category and '6 traguardi raggiunti su 12'; tap on a medal (testID medal-*) opens the flip overlay with 'Tocca per girare' hint; medal-close X is present; Profilo → 'Traguardi del Cammino' (testID menu-/traguardi) navigates to /traguardi and renders 12 medals.

minor.issue: Used u['id'] but user documents store id under user_id → 500 KeyError('id'). Fixed by using u.get('user_id') or u.get('id').

react_native_issues.issue: Full-screen backdrop uses <Pressable style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} onPress={onClose}> covering the whole root; nested Pressable on the medal for toggle may allow click bubbling on RNW so a second tap to flip can also fire the backdrop onClose. Manual note in review says overlay works on native — flagging only for web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/bacheca/MedalDetailOverlay.tsx:70-75

action_items: Consider adding a stopPropagation on medal Pressable (or restructure backdrop) so the flip tap doesn't also dismiss the overlay on React Native Web. Native platforms unaffected.
Re-verify assign/unassign flow via Admin UI (/app/frontend/app/admin/achievements/[id].tsx) to ensure the successful 200 is reflected in the UI toast/state after the backend fix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py assign/unassign endpoints assumed schema key 'id' on users collection but registration and everywhere else uses 'user_id' — introduced a subtle 500. Now guarded with u.get('user_id') or u.get('id').

MedalDetailOverlay.tsx: layering of full-screen backdrop Pressable behind a nested Pressable can cause tap-through on RNW; add event.stopPropagation or wrap with a non-clickable View to stop bubbling.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing seeded demo user bacheca_demo@test.it and default achievements/walk_board. Test-created admin achievements are cleaned up in-test (create → assign → unassign → delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin auth uses email/password login for pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / AdminTestPwd1! (allowlist admin). Demo user for achievements is bacheca_demo@test.it / Test1234! with pre-seeded 3 completed plans, 12 podcasts in history, 2 verse bookmarks, 1 meditation interaction → earned_count=6/12. GET /api/me/achievements is idempotent: earned_at is stored in user_achievements collection via $setOnInsert.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/admin/achievements/{id}/assign returned 500 because the code accessed u['id'] on a users document that uses 'user_id' as the identifier field. Reproduction: 1) login as admin, 2) POST /api/admin/achievements/{aid}/assign body {email: bacheca_demo@test.it} → 500 Internal Server Error, backend traceback KeyError('id'). Mitigation applied: switched to uid = u.get('user_id') or u.get('id') in both assign and unassign handlers. Retested — pytest test_manual_assign_and_unassign now passes.
